coverage_notes: Partial initial registry: four state education agency pages and the Delaware statewide feed; target_states expresses intended 50-state scope, not verified coverage.
State agency listings do not provide complete school district procurement coverage.
Listings may include grants, closed or withdrawn notices, non-K12 work, and non-RFP/RFI opportunities; each notice requires qualification.
NY and ID have exhibited TLS/access failures during verification; report fetch failures explicitly and never treat them as no opportunities.

Delaware uses official agency mappings and explicit RFP/RFI types only; null types without RFP/RFI in the title and same-day deadlines are withheld. Feed includes some school districts, not complete district coverage.
